title: measure_packet_motion.py parses --xmax without validating argv shape, crashing on malformed input
detail: Flag value indexed and int()-converted with no guard: a trailing --xmax or non-numeric value raises an uncaught IndexError/ValueError traceback instead of the tool's own usage error. Crash-only; no injection or exposure.
recommended_fix: Wrap the --xmax parse in try/except (or argparse) and exit 2 with the usage message on a missing or non-integer value.
